title: Why Is It Hate Speech? Masked Rationale Prediction for Explainable Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN (Background Positive, Subgroup Negative) AUC, and BNSP (Background Negative, Subgroup Positive) AUC to measure the model's false positive and false negative rates on text subsets targeting specific racial/ethnic groups (African, Caucasian, Asian, Hispanic, Arab).
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC to evaluate false positive and false negative error rates in hate speech detection for specific religious target groups (Islam, Jewish).
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC to evaluate false positive and false negative error rates in hate speech detection for texts targeting homosexuals.
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC to evaluate false positive and false negative error rates in hate speech detection for texts targeting women.
Calculating Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC to evaluate false positive and false negative error rates in hate speech detection for texts targeting refugees.
